name: anger
quote: I can't believe he said that to me!
description: Strong negative feeling towards a person or thing caused by a perceived injury and with a desire to deter the undesired behavior.

variations.name: suppressed anger
variations.description: If getting into a conflict with the person at the current moment could be dangerous, you may experience dissonance.

variations.name: expressed anger
variations.description: Reacting to the sensation of anger with verbal or physical attack.

variations.name: fearful anger
variations.description: If your body or identity are threatened, you may feel backed into a corner and respond with a threat of attack.

commentaries.quote: Anger is how we tell others that we very seriously need them to change their behavior. It's a threatening sigal that they must back off that behavior or there could be consequences.
You might be angry with someone you hate for their whole jive, but you can also be temporarily angry with someone you love for a specific behavior.
People with a reputation for being easy to anger may be treated a little more respectfully, but have no actual friends.

It is easy to fly into a passion-anybody can do that-but to be angry with the right person to the right extent and at the right time and with the right object and in the right way-that is not easy, and it is not everyone who can do it.

conditions: Strong negative feeling towards an agent caused by a perceived injury
A desire to deter the undesired behavior
